text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus and Shinko Windy brilliantly 
put on a thrilling, heated race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy rejoiced that her running was 
finally being viewed properly. Biko 
Pegasus felt truly relieved from the 
bottom of her heart that she had saved 
her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus looked around to see if there 
was anyone else in need of help, but 
finding people who actually needed 
rescuing wasn't that easy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At times like this, one must conserve 
their strength. Biko Pegasus sets her 
sights on her true specialty— the turf 
sprint, the Takamatsunomiya Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Narita Brian, who ran elsewhere 
on the same day, finished out of the 
placings. She then declared that her next 
race would be the Takamatsunomiya Kinen.
